# O'Dovey AI

> O'Dovey AI (a d/b/a of O'Dovey Ventures LLC) is a professional services firm of forward deployed engineers for agentic AI. We build and deploy agentic solutions and platforms for organizations, enable their engineering teams through co-build and advisory, and deliver corporate training.

## About

O'Dovey AI embeds experienced engineers with client teams to build agentic AI solutions and deploy them into the client's environment. Engagements span the whole stack: the shared platform agents run on (model access, routing, policy, observability), workflow-based and autonomous agents, custom agent harnesses the organization owns, and the integrations that connect agents to data and systems. Everything we deploy is built for production, covering persistence, safety and security, observability, resilience, performance, and evaluation.

We are vendor-neutral and do not resell models or platforms. Our engineering practice is grounded in harness engineering: every agent is a model inside a harness. We teach it through an open curriculum: https://github.com/averagejoeslab/harness-engineering

Based in Houston, Texas; engagements are delivered remotely or on-site.

## Services

### Advisory
- Agentic AI Strategy & Use-Case Design: use-case discovery, model and technology selection, solution architecture
- Readiness & Architecture Assessment: platform, infrastructure, and existing agent review with a remediation plan
- Agent Governance & Operating Model: autonomy, approval, and ownership policies

### Build & Deploy
- Agentic Platforms: governed model access, gateway configuration, routing, policy, cost controls, developer experience
- Agents & Agentic Workflows: workflow-based agents, autonomous and multi-agent systems, human-in-the-loop approvals
- Custom Agent Harnesses: internal agents and tools the organization fully owns
- Tools, Integrations & Data: tool design, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, API and data connectors, retrieval
- Deployment & Production Hardening: infrastructure as code, identity and least privilege, tracing and audit, reliability and cost
- Evaluation & Quality: task suites, outcome-based checks, regression gates

### Enable
- Co-Build Engagements: forward deployed engineers build alongside client engineers on a real use case
- Technical Advisory: architecture reviews, design office hours, code reviews
- Platform Team Setup: charter, reference architectures, internal standards

### Training
- Harness Engineering Bootcamp: 2–3 days, build a harness from scratch one primitive at a time
- Production Harness Engineering: 2-day workshop on the six production questions
- Agentic Platform Engineering: 1–2 day workshop
- Evaluating Agents: 1-day workshop
- What Agents Are Made Of: half-day executive briefing
- Custom Programs: tailored, on-site or live virtual
